title: Who's holding the charge at zero? 6-ball fuse tag
description:
Six balls bounce in an arena and one carries a lit charge with a countdown ring. Touching another ball passes it on; at zero the holder bursts and the charge jumps to the nearest ball. The carrier is not passive: it steers toward the nearest ball and moves 30% faster than the rest. Last ball left wins.
Five fuses, five bursts, one survivor. The big number on the floor, the digit on the carrier and the bar under the chips all count the same fuse. Simulated and drawn by code (seed 296), sound synthesized, with no footage, samples or stock media.
Did your pick survive?
synthetic_media_disclosure_reason: Clearly stylised 2D animation of abstract shapes; nothing realistic that could be mistaken for real people, places or events.
